title: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number
statement: Given digits from 2 to 9, return every letter combination the number could spell, using the classic phone keypad. An empty input returns an empty list. Any order is accepted.
hints: Map each digit to its letters. Note that 7 and 9 have four letters, not three.
Then it is a straightforward product: for each letter of the current digit, recurse on the rest.
Handle the empty input as a special case: it returns an empty list, not a list containing an empty string.
